mode: Isolated offline replay of captured consecutive source frames. Actual arrays at YOLO preprocess and ByteTrack.update are tapped in this process only; running production worker was not instrumented. Live inference skips source frames; replay here processes every one of the 20 frames, so tracker IDs/state are not claimed identical to the running worker.
tracker_config:
# CityEye tuning keeps valid small road users while preserving ByteTrack stability.
tracker_type: bytetrack
track_high_thresh: 0.22
track_low_thresh: 0.10
new_track_thresh: 0.22
track_buffer: 30
match_thresh: 0.80
fuse_score: true
